subject: FU-2: Judging-gate deadlock + overlay edge desync — live repro from suggest_links task
description:
Fix the judging-gate deadlock + overlay memory/disk edge desync (relates to existing ready task "FU-2: Judging-gate deadlock + overlay memory/disk edge desync (MEDIUM)"). LIVE REPRO captured 2026-06-16 while dispatching task ae0d4490-d7c7-4efd-be15-3916d9e059bf/1:

SYMPTOMS:
1. A freshly-created task wired with context edges flips to judging:true and NEVER returns to ready — the edge-judge drain (followup/harness-judge-drain) was actively running but only processed `eager:` targets, never this task's wiring edges. start_task is refused while judging:true → the task is permanently unclaimable. Worker burned its budget poll-waiting for the gate to clear.
2. mark_root clears the `unwired` quarantine but does NOT clear judging:true — task stayed not_ready after mark_root (note field updated, status unchanged).
3. remove_dependency edits did NOT persist: 4 calls each returned removed:1, but a subsequent buildGraph still listed all the removed context_deps. Workspace had ~10 concurrent agents writing the shared overlay; this is a lost-update race / overlay memory-disk desync — concurrent overlay.save() clobbers edge removals.

FIX DIRECTIONS:
- judging→ready must have a guaranteed clear path: either the edge-judge drain must cover task wiring edges (not just eager: targets), or the judging-gate timeout (judge.judgingTimeoutMs) must fire reliably and fall the task back to provisional-ready even when its edges are never judged. Verify Judge D's timeout actually triggers.
- mark_root (or a new force-ready) should ALSO clear judging:true — declaring a root should make the task genuinely claimable, not half-claimable.
- overlay edge writes (addEdge/removeEdge) must be concurrency-safe under many agents: atomic read-modify-write or per-edge append journaling, so a concurrent save can't lose another agent's edge mutation.

Acceptance: a wired task reliably becomes claimable; edge removals persist under concurrent writers.
